doc.title: Roscoe Mitchell interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 23, 2023

chapter: Performing and the idea of free jazz
title: Leading groups and rehearsing every day
summary: Asked how he guided groups, he says they rehearsed nine to five every day because taking music for granted means losing.

story.theme_name: Leading a band: choosing, paying and managing players
story.community_name: Big band discipline versus small-group freedom

blocks.x: In the groups you’ve had, some have been what I would guess, assume is, democratically collective, but others that you formed as a leader — you can correct me if I’m not correct but I’m wondering how you guided or directed people in the group if they weren’t performing in a way that helped to fulfill your basic idea.

Well you know we rehearsed man. You know. We rehearsed every day you know. I mean like you wouldn’t have to ask me what are you doing Monday through Friday — you know — we’re rehearsing you know. From about nine to five every day. That’s what we’re doing. You know. I mean like you can’t, you know if you take music for granted you lose, you lose. You take music for granted you lose. So and I mean even if you have rehearsed well, and you might still think you’re not doing that great, but when you go back and listen to it you are actually doing something.
